$comment: Bytes per published entry of each buildable package (its `publishConfig.exports`; `@md2ui/dom/worker` is the Worker's), minified and gzipped (ADR-006; checked by scripts/packages.ts size): the entry and what it imports statically, everything inlined but its peers and the other buildable packages, which have budgets of their own, so every byte is counted once. A chunk loaded on demand is not shipped with the entry. A budget is set from a measured build plus a margin. It is raised only by a recorded decision that names what the bytes buy (ADR-006).
